description: This PHP source file defines the class 'PackageManagerDisplay' which provides static methods for rendering various parts of the package management UI in SuiteCRM, including package trees, license displays, installation grid, and scripts for client-side interactions. It includes methods for building HTML templates, JavaScript arrays, and handling external dependencies related to package installation and management.

classes.name: PackageManagerDisplay
classes.description: A class providing static methods to generate HTML and JavaScript for SuiteCRM's package manager UI, including package trees, license dialogs, and installation grids.

methods.name: buildPackageDisplay
methods.description: Builds the main package management interface including headers, tree view, and action buttons.

methods.name: buildPatchDisplay
methods.description: Builds the interface for patch management, including tree view and license agreement display.

methods.name: buildInstalledGrid
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying installed modules in a grid.

methods.name: buildLoginPanel
methods.description: Creates an HTML login panel for package repository authentication.

methods.name: buildGridOutput
methods.description: Generates the HTML layout for category trees and package selection grids.

methods.name: buildTreeView
methods.description: Creates a package category tree for navigation.

methods.name: getLicenseDisplay
methods.description: Returns HTML for displaying license contents of a package.

methods.name: getDisplayScript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for client-side package management interactions.

methods.name: createJavascriptPackageArray
methods.description: Converts package release data into a JavaScript array string.

methods.name: createJavascriptModuleArray
methods.description: Converts module data into a JavaScript array string for frontend use.

methods.name: buildLicenseOutput
methods.description: Creates HTML layout to inline display a license agreement.
